chunks: "Traveling through stages depletes provisions, worsens character, and wears out clothes; and the travel is eighteen."

key_terms.الْمَنَازِلِ: the stages or stopping places of a journey

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the effects of travel?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام warns of the practical and moral burdens of prolonged travel, noting its effect on supplies, manners, and clothing. The narration presents a concise ethical observation about travel and moderation in undertaking it.
